prompts.chat

The world's largest open-source prompt library for AI
Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and more

formerly known as Awesome ChatGPT Prompts

🌐 Browse Prompts • 📖 Read the Book • 📄 View on GitHub • 🚀 Self-Host

🏆 Featured in Forbes · 🎓 Referenced by Harvard, Columbia · 📄 40+ academic citations · ❤️ Most liked dataset on Hugging Face
⭐ 143k+ GitHub stars · 🏅 GitHub Staff Pick · 🚀 First prompt library (Dec 2022)

Loved by AI pioneers:
Greg Brockman (OpenAI Co-Founder) · Wojciech Zaremba (OpenAI Co-Founder) · Clement Delangue (Hugging Face CEO) · Thomas Dohmke (Former GitHub CEO)

--- ## What is this? A curated collection of **prompts** for AI chat models. Originally created for ChatGPT, these prompts work great with any modern AI assistant. | Browse Prompts | Data Formats | |----------------|--------------| | [prompts.chat](https://prompts.chat/prompts) | [prompts.csv](prompts.csv) | | [PROMPTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f/prompts.chat/main/PROMPTS.md) | [Hugging Face Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/fka/prompts.chat) | **Want to contribute?** Add prompts at [prompts.chat/prompts/new](https://prompts.chat/prompts/new) — they sync here automatically. --- ## 📖 The Interactive Book of Prompting Learn prompt engineering with our **free, interactive guide** — 25+ chapters covering everything from basics to advanced techniques like chain-of-thought reasoning, few-shot learning, and AI agents. **[Start Reading →](https://fka.gumroad.com/l/art-of-chatgpt-prompting)** (Source: https://github.com/f/prompts.chat/tree/main/src/content/book) --- ## 🎮 Prompting for Kids

An interactive, game-based adventure to teach children (ages 8-14) how to communicate with AI through fun puzzles and stories. **[Start Playing →](https://prompts.chat/kids)**
--- ## 🚀 Self-Hosting Deploy your own private prompt library with custom branding, themes, and authentication. **Quick Start:** ```bash npx prompts.chat new my-prompt-library cd my-prompt-library ``` **Manual Setup:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/f/prompts.chat.git cd prompts.chat npm install && npm run setup ``` The setup wizard configures branding, theme, authentication (GitHub/Google/Azure AD), and features. **Recommended database:** prompts.chat uses PostgreSQL. For a hosted database, we recommend [Neon](https://get.neon.com/VqfnMo4).

Sponsored by

📖 **[Full Self-Hosting Guide](SELF-HOSTING.md)** • 🐳 **[Docker Guide](DOCKER.md)** --- ## 🔌 Integrations ### CLI ```bash npx prompts.chat ``` ### Claude Code Plugin ``` /plugin marketplace add f/prompts.chat /plugin install prompts.chat@prompts.chat ``` 📖 [Plugin Documentation](CLAUDE-PLUGIN.md) ### MCP Server Use prompts.chat as an MCP server in your AI tools. **Remote (recommended):** ```json { "mcpServers": { "prompts.chat": { "url": "https://prompts.chat/api/mcp" } } } ``` **Local:** ```json { "mcpServers": { "prompts.chat": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "prompts.chat", "mcp"] } } } ``` 📖 [MCP Documentation](https://prompts.chat/docs/api) --- ## 💖 Sponsors

aiSummary.oneLiner: The world's largest open-source prompt library for interacting with Large Language Models.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: prompts.chat is an expansive, community-driven repository that catalogs highly effective prompts for Large Language Models. It organizes prompts by role, task, and intent, allowing users to quickly find the exact phrasing needed to elicit a specific behavior from an AI. The platform provides a web interface backed by this open-source repository, making it easy to browse, copy, and contribute new prompts. It covers everything from software engineering and creative writing to acting as a Linux terminal or a specialized consultant. By crowdsourcing prompt engineering, it democratizes the ability to effectively communicate with and control AI systems.
keyFeatures: Extensive categorization: Prompts are organized by specific roles and tasks, such as 'Act as a Linux Terminal' or 'Act as an English Translator'.
Community contributions: Leverages the open-source community to continuously refine and add new, effective prompts.
Cross-model compatibility: Provides prompts that are generally effective across various LLMs, including ChatGPT and Claude.
Easy copy-paste interface: The associated website offers a streamlined UI for quickly finding and utilizing prompts.
Role-playing focus: Excels at providing prompts that instruct the AI to assume specific personas with strict behavioral constraints.

useCases.title: Role-Playing and Simulation
useCases.description: Users can copy prompts to make the AI act as a specific system, like a JavaScript console or a travel guide, for interactive testing.

useCases.title: Professional Task Automation
useCases.description: Professionals can find tailored prompts to help draft emails, write code reviews, or summarize complex documents.

useCases.title: Prompt Engineering Research
useCases.description: Researchers can analyze the repository to study effective patterns and structures in prompt design.

useCases.title: Creative Writing Assistance
useCases.description: Writers can utilize specialized prompts to help brainstorm ideas, develop characters, or overcome writer's block.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This library is for anyone who uses AI, from casual users looking for fun interactions to power users and developers needing precise, reliable AI outputs. It is a foundational resource for learning practical prompt engineering.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Visit https://prompts.chat to browse the library.
